## Fresh complete-change judgment

I reassessed the entire delivered change and its cross-milestone relationships with the new RC subject included: approved proposal bounds, Design/System/Workflow and retained installer contract, current RC policy, the unchanged delivery allocation, M1 filesystem transaction and M2 public dispatch, authoring resources/consumers, generated candidates and trust metadata, source retirement and remaining follow-up ownership. The current authority is Design r7 and Delivery r4, not a relabeling of older approvals.

The combined design and realization still fulfill the bounded direction: one authoring owner combines observable requirements, technical reasoning, decisions and acceptance; System owns composed obligations while referencing local owners; Workflow coordinates; specialized review and Verify remain independent. No full-repository consolidation, extra lifecycle gate, runtime record version, semantic readiness engine, per-test ledger or release operation is introduced. Remaining migration is explicitly owned by FU-012–014.

The new RC text now agrees with the already selected RF-SR-06 and CLI-SR-10/18 retirement. Archived v1 bytes and original judgments keep their historical meaning without current reader/writer/continuation authority. The unchanged explicit-recording-v1 model marker and targeted-recording-v1 transport identify their independent version domains, not stored v1. Model-convention references now point to Design, leaving Workflow coordination intact. The original extraction/two-model/adoption narrative is historical context, not current implementation status. Independent Design assessment compared all18 RC requirements and5 decisions unchanged; this whole-change pass also checked their effect on current review, evidence reuse, failed proof, closeout and customer authority. No altered policy needs propagation into published resources or runtime code.

The narrow validator checks those exact retired sources, not arbitrary legacy exemption or semantic adoption. RC's clarification closes stale current compatibility wording without rewriting archived outcomes. |

A historical successful Verify is not replayed as current success. |

All ten Code Review dimensions pass within this exact scope: contract alignment, meaningful proof, named edge cases, error/recovery behavior, ownership/architecture, compatibility, security/permissions, derived currency, bounded scope and sufficient validation. No new material finding is supported. Original des-review-f1–f5 and m1-review-f1/f2 dispositions stay resolved with their origins preserved; the final remedies remain in the exact reviewed implementation and documents.

I independently compared every96 prior final engineering subjects with current file identities: none changed. The complete engineering difference since d62fd3fa is RC alone; attributable review/evidence/routing changes do not alter executable/package behavior. I freshly checked all three archive hashes and confirmed internal RC Markdown is not a packaged file. Existing passed source/package/installed/manual execution proof therefore remains applicable to its known proved surfaces: implementation, test files, archive bytes, procedures and environment are unchanged; RC's18 requirements/5 decisions are unchanged; no newly contrary proof or required freshness override defeats those results. This is affirmative bounded reuse, not identity-only approval or a blanket evidence refresh.

Fresh author-run selected checks were inspected: schema check exit0; model validation passed for CLI/Record Format/RC/Workflow; boundary regression87 passed; change-metadata regression7 passed; full Node454 passed. Registered evidence also records24 passing record-retirement tests. Earlier independent38 helper/16 public DES/3 retirement tests remain truthful prior executions. I did not rerun unchanged implementation suites or describe reused results as new runs.

The13 original installer prose failures remain explicit historical baseline debt with unchanged-body evidence and the existing plan limit; no universal prose success or blanket waiver is inferred. Earlier two retired-method marker failures remain historical failed observations; the reviewed current preservation validator passes. Distinct Verify owns applicability and final completion. Previous hosted CI belongs to its old PR head; no new refinement CI or external action is claimed here.

## Independence and preserved history

Independent nonauthor /root/independent_design_review. Primary-agent authored the complete production contribution, including the post-PR RC clarification under explicit user direction. This reviewer authored only review/evidence and disposable semantic fixtures, no governed production subject. Fresh complete-diff/dependency assessment and exact comparison establish separation and current scope; prior milestone/final approval labels are not substituted for this judgment.

The original final review is byte-preserved. The earlier successful Verify was preserved as complete historical evidence before any new singular report is produced; its outcome remains attached to its original subjects. This review changes no engineering, work, route, prior judgment or external PR state.
